q.question: Identify the correct Indirect form - She said, "I would like to see it." (Change to Indirect speech)
options: She said that she had liked to see it.
She said that she would like to see it.
She said she had been liking to see it.
She said that she liked to see it.

14.explanation: प्रत्यक्ष कथन को अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में बदलते समय, यदि रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब भूतकाल में हो (जैसे 'said'), तो 'would' में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं होता है। 'I' को रिपोर्टिंग सब्जेक्ट 'She' के अनुसार 'she' में बदल दिया जाता है। अतः, "She said, 'I would like to see it.'" का अप्रत्यक्ष रूप "She said that she would like to see it." होगा।
14.fact: She said, "I would like to see it." का अप्रत्यक्ष रूप "She said that she would like to see it." है।
14.subject: General Science
